newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Newly listed Rebhold cautions shareholders.
newsitem.headline: Newly listed Rebhold cautions shareholders.

text.p: Newly listed South African liquor, food and freight-forwarding firm Rebhold Ltd said on Wednesday that it is engaged in negotiations which could, if successfully concluded, effect its share price.
"Shareholders are therefore advised to exercise caution when dealing in Rebhold shares until a further announcement is made," the firm said.
Rebhold listed on October 16 in a private placing of 23 million shares that attracted heavy market interest and had been fully subscribed.
In a statement after the listing Rebhold chief executive Jacques Kempen said the firm now had funds to finance several buys as part of the next phase of its long-term growth strategy.
He added he was unable to give any exact details of the planned deals.
The firm has also said its earnings are forecast to grow at least 20 percent to 20.5 cents a share in the year to end-June, 1997, from 17.1 cents a share in the same period this year.
